text:
maria: Heads up — noticed quota double-counting in the Console when route-policy is set to `narrowcast`. It shows consumed on both Hosted and Dedicated. Repro: create route header `X-Route-Policy: {\"target\":\"dedicated\",\"affinity\":\"session\"}`, send 3 requests -> Console shows 6 tokens. Anyone else seen this?

devon: saw this during a canary yesterday. Console telemetry pipeline is attributing tokens to both the route and fallback buckets.

sam: is this a console aggregation bug or are SDKs duplicating headers?

aisha: quick check — Python SDK still emits the legacy `X-Redwood-Routing` header for backward compat in addition to the new `X-Route-Policy`. TS has an opt-in flag to stop sending legacy header. That could explain double attribution.

maria: here's the exact payload we send from the py client: ```
{"route": "dedicated", "policy": "narrowcast", "affinity": "session"}
``` — we should avoid sending the legacy header when the new header is present.

devon: console-side de-dupe could be a short-term fix: prefer the new header if both are present. But we should also fix SDK behavior.

sam: agreed. If SDKs are sending both, console will be noisy forever unless we change one side.

julian: prefer coordinated approach: SDK change + a short-lived console de-dupe for safety. Console-only fix can mask SDK regressions if left long.

maria: proposed rollout: 1) Add a Python SDK feature flag to disable legacy header (default: enabled for now). 2) Make TS/Go default to NOT emit legacy header in next major. 3) Add console de-dupe to map to single attribution while SDKs migrate. 4) Add telemetry tag to monitor dual-attribution. Any concerns?

aisha: timeline?

maria: tentative: py flag PR tomorrow, console de-dupe by EOW, TS/Go major next sprint.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for py-sdk/feature/route-header-flag (sha: abc1234) to staging.

devon: I'll add a Console dashboard tile showing the rate of dual-attribution and tokens duplicated so we can watch during rollout.

sam: also add sampled audit logs for header presence per request so we can confirm when legacy header is absent.

julian: fine with that. I'll draft release notes and a short migration snippet for customers.

maria: assigning follow-ups: @maria (open py PR + tests), @devon (console de-dupe + dashboard tile), @sam (telemetry sampling + audit logs), @julian (release notes), @aisha (coordinate TS/Go changes).

aisha: I'll open TS/Go issues today and tag owners.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: 

(Notes: keep console de-dupe limited to 2 weeks and emit an internal metric when de-dupe logic is used so we can validate SDK rollouts. Also add an SDK test that verifies only one routing header is emitted when `route_policy` is present.)
